BEGIN;
-- CUTOVER: no historical revisions or policies are fabricated for legacy items.
CREATE TABLE lesson_completion_policy (
 lesson_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 activities jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(activities)='array'),
 updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE lesson_revision (
 id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
 lesson_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES lesson(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 content_hash char(64) NOT NULL CHECK (content_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 definition jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(definition)='object'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 UNIQUE (lesson_id,content_hash)
);
CREATE TABLE generated_course_revision_receipt (
 idempotency_key uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES generated_course_request(idempotency_key) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 lessons jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(lessons)='array')
);
CREATE FUNCTION reject_lesson_revision_mutation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'lesson revisions are immutable'; END;
$$;
CREATE TRIGGER lesson_revision_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON lesson_revision
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_lesson_revision_mutation();
CREATE TRIGGER generated_course_revision_receipt_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON generated_course_revision_receipt
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_lesson_revision_mutation();
COMMIT;
